mapper.update: UPDATE t_erp_customer_account SET is_default = 0 WHERE customer_id = #{customerId, jdbcType=CHAR} AND is_default = 1
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.customer_id, a.company_name, a.account_number, a.is_default, a.status, a.bank_name, a.remark, c.name customer_name FROM t_erp_customer_account a INNER JOIN t_erp_customer c ON c.id = a.customer_id WHERE c.shopid = #{shopid, jdbcType=CHAR} ORDER BY c.name, a.is_default DESC
